basis: Non-GAAP EPS of $3.70 beat the $3.00-3.10 guide; the tariff refund was 'received as expected', so it was in the guide. The operating margin beat too, at 11.1% against about 9.5%. But the FY guidance is only reaffirmed despite the Q2 beat, which implies a softer second half, and the $439M goodwill impairment on 'geopolitical/macro' assumptions is a mild negative signal.
